summary: This Form 6-K filed by Trillion Energy International Inc. provides its unaudited condensed consolidated interim financial statements for the three months ended March 31, 2026 and 2025, along with management discussion and analysis. It is a routine periodic financial reporting filing under the SEC's Exchange Act for a foreign private issuer, not a special-situation event. The filing includes balance sheets showing assets held for sale and liabilities held for sale, but it does not announce any binding acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC merger, or forced management change. As a standard quarterly report, it falls outside the defined special-situation categories.
